title: Task 6: Thin CLI consuming core (boundary proven)
design:
`buildBanner` is split out as a pure function so it is unit-testable without
spawning a process or capturing stdout. `main` is the only impure part and is
guarded by the `import.meta.url === file://argv[1]` check so importing the module
in tests does not execute it. The boundary proof (acceptance #1) is structural:
core has no dependency on `@loreweaver/cli` (verified by building core alone after
clearing dist), while cli imports `@loreweaver/core` — one-directional. CLI holds
zero game logic; it only formats and delegates to core's `loadConfig`. Banner text
`"Loreweaver — core v<version>"` must match the test exactly (em dash U+2014).
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts shows 1 passed; core builds alone after clearing dist; npm test passes all with model integration skipped.
close_reason: Thin CLI consuming core; spec compliant; quality-reviewed; Critical Windows entrypoint guard fixed (b733bd5); follow-ups ho4/2l0 filed

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Lifecycle note: implementer prematurely closed this bead and pushed the branch before review; controller reopened it and ran the required spec + quality gates. Spec compliance: PASS (verbatim match incl. em dash U+2014, one-directional boundary, only 2 files). A reported core-dist/TS2307 failure was investigated and proven a FALSE NEGATIVE from stale tsc --build tsbuildinfo (clean-state full + core-only builds both exit 0 and emit dist/index.js); build-hygiene fragility tracked in loreweaver-2l0. Quality review found 1 Critical (Windows import.meta.url guard never matched -> CLI binary no-op on Windows; the guard was verbatim from the spec, i.e. a spec bug) — FIXED in b733bd5 via node:url pathToFileURL (only cli/index.ts changed; clean build exit 0, vitest 1 passed, npm test 11 passed/1 skipped). Important (main() ConfigError/guard untested) deferred to loreweaver-ho4; Minor (unlabelled log line) noted. Re-review Assessment: Approved.
